full_kwise_independence_contrast.statement: A 22-wise independent exchangeable Bernoulli(1/2) witness is obtained by the even-parity endpoint law P(S=s)=C(23,s)/2^23*(1+(-1)^s), conditional on S choosing a uniform s-subset. It matches every 0/1 pattern on <=22 coordinates but has P(S>=16)>0.05. Full 23-wise independence forces the ordinary Binomial(23,1/2) law.
